title: A delegated payment can leave two live approval cards, a denied card that comes back to life, and a run that shows 'could not finish' while it is only waiting
root_cause: Observed by one user (R1) on a fresh thread: a long request made the bot message the Mercury agent twice, giving two cards. After the newer card was denied, the older card showed live Send/Deny again (also after reload) and its Send produced 'Submitted' in the same thread that said 'you denied'. J2 saw the same family on the other side: the delegate run ended with no final answer after an approval was created, the card became 'No longer active', the composer said 'could not finish', and Retry added a second identical user bubble. Common cause: the card's lifecycle is derived on the client ('a newer live card exists') instead of being stored, and a run that pauses on approval or fails after creating one has no server-side state saying so.
verification: Observed (R1-01 on one user, J2-01 on one user). Cause suspected. Code: pauseForAsk/resume in packages/adapters/src/executor.ts; superseded state is computed in apps/web/src/components/AskCard.tsx; MISSING_TOOL_FINAL_RESPONSE_ERROR at packages/contracts/src/domain.ts:1152. Not traced further.
files: packages/adapters/src/executor.ts (pauseForAsk, resume, relay: mark older pending approvals superseded when a newer one is created; reject approving a superseded or denied card; replace the interim relay message with the final one)
packages/adapters/src/executor-approval-replay.test.ts (regressions: second request supersedes the first; denied card cannot be approved; failed run after an approval expires it)
apps/web chat run-status banner (show 'waiting for approval' for a run paused on an approval, not 'could not finish')
Retry handler in the chat composer (do not add a second user bubble)
reach: Anyone who lets a bot move money. Contradictory payment outcomes in one thread.
acceptance_criteria: One user, clean thread: one payment request leads to exactly one live card even when the bot messages the Mercury agent twice; the older card reads 'No longer active' and has no buttons, also after reload.
Deny the newer card: the older card stays inactive and cannot be approved; the thread never shows both 'denied' and 'Submitted' for one request.
A run paused on an approval shows 'Waiting for approval', not 'This agent could not finish', after a reload.
If a delegate run fails after creating an approval, that approval is expired and the error says nothing was sent; Retry does not add a second identical user bubble.
One outcome message per delegated request (interim relay message replaced by the final one).
conflicts_with: C4 (executor relay wording) only if C4 touches executor.ts
reopens: iteration 11 C1 (single-user repro now exists, stays P1)
